title: Farmslot live recipe player and output artifacts smoke
description: Replays a UI-class recipe on a warm slot, watches the stream stay visible, follows runner logs, and inspects newly created artifacts.

pre_conditions.description: Project recipe_run hook supports the selected UI recipe.

open-slot-recipe-panel.intent: Open the slot Recipe panel for a warm slot without placing a modal over the live stream.

start-live-replay.intent: Press replay live recipe with the default 2 second visualization delay.

watch-stream-and-logs.intent: Watch the streaming panel and recipe runner logs until the replay completes or fails.

open-new-artifacts.intent: Open the newly generated attempted-run artifacts from the same Recipe panel.

capture-replay-result.intent: Capture the live replay result with stream, logs, and generated artifacts visible.

index-artifacts.intent: Publish replay screenshot, runner log, replay report, trace, summary, and resolved recipe.
